title: Underwriting Guideline: Builder Extended Rate Lock Term Eligibility
content:
A Builder Extended Rate Lock term may be requested only when the loan and the home meet that term's thresholds. The same tests apply when a lock's terms are changed.

## Tests for a term

1. The loan program is one of the term's eligible programs.
2. The loan amount does not exceed the largest loan amount accepted on any lock.
3. The loan-to-value percent does not exceed the term's highest loan-to-value.
4. The qualifying credit score is at least the term's minimum qualifying credit score.
5. The qualifying debt-to-income percent does not exceed the term's highest qualifying debt-to-income.
6. A loan amount above the conforming limit must be on program jumbo.
7. The home's construction stage on the purchase agreement must be at or past the term's earliest construction stage when the lock is requested. The stage order is not started, foundation, framing, drywall, finishes, complete.
8. The estimated completion date on the purchase agreement must be at least the term's minimum days to estimated completion, in calendar days, after the request date.
9. A term whose lock term ends before the estimated completion date is not offered.

## Authority for the construction stage

The construction stage is read from the system record of the purchase agreement the lock finances, as it stands when the lock is requested; the buyer's own description of the build does not replace it.

## Boundary readings (hypothetical figures)

| Test | Just meets | Just fails |
|---|---|---|
| Credit score "at least" the minimum | score equal to the minimum | one point below the minimum |
| Loan-to-value "does not exceed" | loan-to-value equal to the highest | any amount above it |
| Stage "at or past" | home at the earliest stage itself | home one stage earlier in the order |
| Days to estimated completion "at least" | exactly the minimum number of days | one day fewer |

## Stage examples

- Hypothetical: a term whose earliest stage is framing. A home at framing, drywall, finishes or complete meets test 7; a home at not started or foundation does not.
- Hypothetical: a loan amount one dollar above the conforming limit on a conventional program fails test 6; the same amount on program jumbo passes it.
